name: Cynicism
overview: Scripture reveals cynicism as a heart condition rooted in unbelief and rejection of God, exemplified in Psalms 14:1 where denying God's existence is linked to corruption and folly. Jesus addresses this unbelief directly, teaching that even a small measure of genuine faith can accomplish the impossible (Matthew 17:20). The gospel counters cynicism by affirming God's love through Christ's sacrifice (John 3:16) and the abundant life He offers (John 10:10). True hope and assurance come exclusively through Jesus, the way, the truth, and the life (John 14:6), calling believers to trust in God's promises rather than harboring doubt or skepticism (Acts 1:4).
